source_text: The interaction begins when the medication schedule triggers a reminder event. → User clarified: 10.0 seconds
If no acknowledgement is received within 8 seconds, the robot should repeat the prompt.
Once the patient provides a valid acknowledgement, the robot must verbally confirm receipt of the response within 1 second.
The patient does not respond after two retry attempts.
The robot fails to provide confirmation after receiving an acknowledgement.
The complete interaction should finish within 30 seconds from the initial prompt.
If the patient provides an unclear response, the robot may request clarification once.
